_comment: Hand-labelled MANDATORY requirements of 7 synthetic seed notices, for the Compliance metric (api/scripts/score_compliance.py). FICTIONAL data (seed notices + demo company). Labelled 2026-10-19 (Prompt 7) by reading each notice in data/seed_tenders/.
_labelling_rules: One label per distinct mandatory requirement the bidder must meet or submit. A compound line (e.g. 'registration and class D licence renewed for 2083/84') is split into its parts. Conditional items (JV agreement 'if a JV') are not labelled.
quote: verbatim from the notice (checked by tests/test_compliance.py). text: the requirement in plain English (it becomes Requirement.text in oracle records).

expected: what a careful human reviewer would conclude for the DEMO COMPANY from its KB (data/demo_company/, incl. 05_company_profile.pdf) and profile, at 2026-10-19 12:00 NPT. pass = the KB shows it is met; fail = the KB shows it is not; unclear = the KB cannot show it either way, or it is prepared per bid (self-declaration, bid security).
hard: true when failing it disqualifies the bid. Every expected=fail label here is hard, so it must come out as a hard fail (missing one is the worst error).
rule_id: the deterministic rule that should cover it. Labels without rule_id are left to the model layer; keywords match the item's requirement text (case-insensitive) in that case.

record: the oracle Scout output for compliance (required_docs, criteria, bid security, bid validity). Deadline, cost, buyer, type and method come from data/seed_tenders/manifest.json. Criteria counts ('at least one') are filled as an ideal extraction would; Scout does not yet extract min_similar_projects (PROGRESS issue 18).
